description: Evidence manifest proving persistent RBAC users, roles, permissions, and user-role assignments were applied from rbac_policy.v1.json.
rules: permissions must cover every non-public operation permission plus admin from the RBAC seed
roles must match the standard role permission sets from the RBAC seed
every enabled user must have at least one role assignment
at least one enabled user must have the admin role
assignments must reference enabled users and standard roles
notes: This contract validates captured RBAC assignment evidence only. A platform DB collector should emit this after applying RBAC seed records.
